title: Mnemonic
slide_intent: Treat sound as a repeatable identity cue so recognition can occur without a visible logo.
strategic_value: A consistent sonic signature can connect T-Mobile audio encounters to its visual identity.
demonstration: A magenta waveform accompanies guidance on the mnemonic’s key, duration and tempo; this PDF provides no playable sound.
practical_value: Choose the hero key for isolated use or a supplied alternate key to fit existing music.

content_islands.name: Audio-use instructions
content_islands.spec: Place the title and key, timing and access guidance at left.

content_islands.name: Waveform specimen
content_islands.spec: Center a large magenta waveform in the right-hand white field.

ingredient.name: Audio mnemonic
ingredient.role: Identify T-Mobile through a short recurring sound.
ingredient.application: Use the primary C-key version without music or other tones; choose from eleven alternate keys when needed for harmony. Duration is 2.5 seconds at 108 bpm.
ingredient.scope: Audio creative; the waveform is illustrative and no audio asset is bundled in this PDF.
